name: Blunt-lobed woodsia
desc: Blunt-lobed woodsia (Physematium obtusum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Physematium obtusum, the bluntlobe cliff fern, is a common rock fern of Appalachia and eastern North America. It prefers a calcareous substrate, but also grows in neutral soils.
